description: §42.4 statement 10: `const v = !g()` and `keep(!g())` are value positions (silent); `if (!(g() is given))` is the explicit fix — admitted.
rationale: §42.4 statement 10: "Operands outside a condition (`const v = !g()`, …) stay provable-or-silent." Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S460 "a on F2, go" ("Operands OUTSIDE conditions stay provable-or-silent (S440 Q2)").
